summary_en: Share count ceiling raised from 200,000 to 300,000 shares (1.22%→1.85% of S/O ex-treasury). Total acquisition price ceiling remains ¥200M. Execution period 2025-12-01 to 2026-11-30. Method: open-market purchase on TSE. As of 2026-06-30, 164,800 shares acquired for ¥123.2M under prior authorization.
title_en: Notice of Expansion of Share Buyback Authorization (Treasury Share Acquisition pursuant to Company Law Article 459(1) and Articles of Incorporation Article 8)
translation_en_brief: Space Shower SKIYAKI Holdings announced on 2026-07-24 an expansion of its treasury share acquisition authorization. The company raised the authorized share count ceiling from 200,000 to 300,000 shares (from 1.22% to 1.85% of outstanding shares excluding treasury) while holding the total acquisition price ceiling constant at ¥200M. The execution period remains 2025-12-01 through 2026-11-30, with purchases to be made via open-market transactions on the TSE. The expansion supports the company's mid-term plan "Ignite 2027" (covering fiscal 2026–2028), which targets annual opportunistic buybacks up to ¥200M. As of 2026-06-30, the company had acquired 164,800 shares for ¥123.2M under the prior authorization, bringing the share count close to the original 200,000-share ceiling and necessitating the increase to continue execution. The company maintains a stable ¥200M annual acquisition budget across the three-year plan.
